The people building frontier AI models see early signals about where capabilities are heading and which developer skills and workflows are about to matter most. Recorded live at GitHub Universe 2026, this panel brings together leaders from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Cloud, and GitHub Copilot for a forward-looking discussion on where AI-assisted development is heading over the next two years. Learn how frontier models, autonomous agents, and MCP integrations will reshape software architecture, code security, and everyday workflows. Explore more sessions and announcements at https://githubuniverse.com 

Speakers: 
April Leonard, VP of Engineering for GitHub Copilot, GitHub 
Angela Jiang, Head of Product, Claude Platform, Anthropic 
Richard Seroter, Senior Director and Chief Evangelist, Google Cloud 
Rohan Varma, Product Lead, Enterprise Agents, OpenAI 

Watch more videos from GitHub Universe 2026: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AArI948SDz8&list=PLENrlACZ7mnU

author: GitHub
description:
A vulnerability is a mistake. Malware is on purpose. In this Security in 60 Seconds short, Carlin Cherry explains how attackers get malicious code into your dependencies: they steal a maintainer's account and poison a package you already trust, or publish a lookalike name and wait for a typo. Malware can run the moment you install it, before your code ever calls it. Block known malicious packages before they're installed with the GitHub package firewall, and use Dependabot to get alerted if malware is already in your dependencies.

Learn more about Dependabot malware alerts: https://gh.io/dependabot-malware

author: GitHub
description:
Join us for Open Source Friday with Madelyn Olson, Valkey co-creator, maintainer, and Technical Steering Committee member.

Valkey is an open source, high-performance key-value data store used for caching, real-time applications, and workloads that need fast access to data. We’ll explore what it does, the story behind the project, and how its community is shaping its future.

Learn more and contribute at https://github.com/valkey-io/valkey.
title: Meet Valkey | Open Source Friday
